# FST Logistics

FST Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. FST Logistics is a logistics company that provides dry & temperature-controlled 3PL services to the complex shipping and storage needs of grocery and retail brands. FST Logistics employs 306 people (-3.5% YoY, -11 people) and has an annual revenue of $137M, founded in 1991. Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, United States, with offices in Columbus, Fort Worth, Grove City, and Rogers. Its workforce is distributed across United States, India, and United Kingdom.

## About

Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, FST Logistics is an employee-owned company with over 30-years of experience providing dry and temperature-controlled transportation and warehousing services. With over 1.8 million square feet of dry, refrigerated, and frozen space FST specializes in scaling with brands of all sizes to meet the rigorous demands of today's complex E-commerce and supply chain needs.

# FST Logistics & Transportation

FST Logistics & Transportation is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Fuentes and Sons Transportation is a company that specializes in specialized heavy haul, flatbed, drayage and break bulk, warehousing and storage, freight forwarding, international & cross-border shipping. FST Logistics & Transportation employs 31 people (+10.7% YoY, +3 people), founded in 2004. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, United States, with offices in Rancho Cucamonga, Perris, and San Bernardino. Its workforce is distributed across United States and El Salvador.

## About

Founded in 2004 by Carlos Fuentes, Fuentes and Sons Transportation has grown into one of the largest flatbed fleets in the western United States. Specializing in project logistics, over-dimensional freight, and military shipments, FST is the foremost leader in logistics to help build and keep America safe. Even as we grow our fleet, we still offer third-party logistics services using our trusted network of carriers. As we've grown, we're continually updating our technology to be one of the most technologically advanced logistics companies in the United States. We constantly strive to help our customers improve efficiency and effectiveness as well as cut costs in every possible aspect of business.
